headlines.title: Dowman to miss three matches after appeal rejected
headlines.description: Arsenal's Max Dowman will miss three matches after an appeal against his sending-off during Tuesday's loss at Fleetwood is rejected.

headlines.title: Mourinho and chaos - is Real Madrid boss misunderstood?
headlines.description: Jose Mourinho has spent the past decade seeing other managers hailed as geniuses, but did Real Madrid's win at Barcelona show he's been misunderstood?

headlines.title: Russo scores hat-trick as Arsenal beat Benfica
headlines.description: Alessia Russo becomes England's all-time leading goalscorer in the Women's Champions League with a hat-trick in Arsenal's 3-0 win over Benfica.
